speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a marvel how small an ailment is, and how much of a man's morning it will command.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen lines, and a corner cut off so I should not look at a blot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They asked if I was ill. I said I was well. I could have worked, had they left the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Titus went on at two without me. I am not in it. That is not the loss.
